limits.text: Message and Destination never live in server actions; Download only in screen actions; RecordListToExcel only in server actions (ODC census of 45 real modules).
A Message node lives in a screen action, an On Exception handler or a system event; in a server action the create is refused (declared in a job comment, no negative job).
limits.origin: job:switch-exception-handler (op 47 _why: On Exception handler or system event, refused in a server action); job:logic-native-nodes (op 18: screen action)

limits.text: A Message node discards the create name (address #IMessageNode); its text is a literal and does not follow a rename.
The compact step creates OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.<Type>; for send email on ODC the proven path is raw create ISendEmailNode (resolves to the Mobile type).
Closed properties: all required unless defaulted; Refresh Data StartIndex must stay empty; only JavaScript declares inputs/outputs; args only on nodes with arguments.

no ajax refresh (no Traditional Web); attach file undetermined (the Mobile send-email type has its own Attachments setter)
